edges.reason: onlyOwner startGame writes the supplied liquidityPool into privileged state used by reward logic
onlyOwner startGame assigns seed1, controlling the random outcome
onlyOwner startGame assigns seed2 derived from _randModulus
startGame sets gameStarted to true, activating the game
startGame sets chanceRate
startGame calls _randModulus to derive seed2
transfer passes msg.sender, recipient and amount into _getAmount
transferFrom passes sender, recipient and amount into _getAmount
_getAmount invokes _sendReward when the game is started
_getAmount invokes _getRandomBurnedAmount to compute the burn
_getAmount burns sender balance by burnAmount
gameStarted gates the reward and burn branches inside _getAmount
hasGameStarted returns the gameStarted state flag
_sendReward calls _play to decide whether the liquidity-pool sender wins
_sendReward mints amount.mul(10) to recipient on a pseudo-random win, inflating supply
liquidityPool is compared against the transfer sender to unlock rewards
_getRandomBurnedAmount calls _randModulus with seed2
seed2 feeds the burn rate computation
_play calls _randModulus twice
_play derives val1 from seed1, an owner-set random seed
_play derives val2 from seed2, a derived random seed
_randModulus increments the nonce each call
transfer uses _msgSender() as the sender
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender
msg.sender is mixed into the keccak256 randomness, allowing caller influence over game outcomes
block.timestamp (now) is used as a randomness source, making results miner-manipulable
_randModulus produces predictable randomness from nonce, seed, now, block.difficulty and msg.sender

normalization_plan.reason: _liquidityPool is only consumed by startGame to set privileged liquidityPool state
_seed1 is only consumed by startGame to initialize seed1 and seed2
recipient flows through transfer paths into _sendReward where the reward is minted to it
amount is the value transformed by _getAmount before reward/burn
sender is compared against liquidityPool inside _sendReward
mod is the modulus argument of the random generator
seed is the randomness seed argument of _randModulus
burnAmount is the local result of _getRandomBurnedAmount consumed in _getAmount
val1 is a local comparison value inside _play
val2 is a local comparison value inside _play
burnrate is the local divisor computed inside _getRandomBurnedAmount
rand is the local pseudo-random output produced inside _randModulus
